votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of Tuesday, December 8, 2020.
votes.description: The Board approved the official minutes from the December 8, 2020 RDA meeting.

votes.motion: Ratify the Chair's determination to continue meeting remotely and without an anchor location.
votes.description: The Board ratified the Chair's decision to hold the meeting electronically without a physical anchor location due to health and safety concerns and closure of the City and County Building to the public.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 14 of 2021, adopting the Housing Development funding priorities for FY 2021-2022 with final funding priorities identified as presented.
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution formalizing the RDA's affordable housing development funding priorities for Fiscal Year 2021-22, providing policy direction for RDA staff on funding allocations and interest rate reductions.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for §52-4-205(l)(d) strategy sessions to discuss the purchase, exchange, or lease of real property, and for Attorney-Client matters that are privileged pursuant to Utah Code §78B-1-137, and for other lawful purposes that satisfy the pertinent requirements of the Utah Open and Public Meetings Act.
votes.description: The Board voted to enter a closed session to discuss real property transactions and attorney-client privileged matters.
